meta.target: OWASP Juice Shop v20.4.0 (Windows standalone zip)
meta.scope: Black-box scan expectations a working QualityPilot default surface MUST produce. Every expectation carries a liveCheck the harness re-verifies against the running target before scoring, so target drift cannot fake a recall number.
meta.denominatorNote: Only 'expected' entries count toward recall. 'observational' findings are reported but never scored: they depend on crawl depth, app state, or browser behavior and are not deterministic.

expected.rationale: Juice Shop serves no Content-Security-Policy on any route (verified by direct header probe 2026-11-16).
Target serves everything over plain HTTP (localhost standalone). The security executor flags unencrypted transport per probed URL.

mustNotFind.rationale: HSTS rule is HTTPS-only; the rule must skip plain-HTTP targets, not report 'missing HSTS' on them.
Juice Shop serves X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff — flagging it would be a false positive.
Juice Shop serves X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN — flagging it would be a false positive.
Secure-flag audit is HTTPS-only; must not fire on an HTTP target.
Juice Shop sets no SameSite=None cookie on unauthenticated routes; firing would be a false positive.
Same-scheme localhost target cannot produce mixed content; firing would be a false positive.

observational.note: axe-core results vary with crawl set and app state (e.g. contrast on dynamically rendered pages); reported, not scored.
Browser console errors depend on runtime state.
Broken-link results depend on crawl frontier and HEAD/GET behavior of the target.
Failed-request classification depends on crawl-time app behavior.
Mutation testing results depend on inferred forms/targets.
